end.summary:
Defined chemical change through examples and signs.
Identified gas, colour change, heat, light, smell, and new solid as chemical-change signs.
Practised physical-change examples; melting ghee was correctly identified after discussion.
Melting ice was still classified as chemical change; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised distinguishing physical and chemical changes using ice, ghee, chapati, and cooking examples. They correctly used signs such as light, heat, colour change, smell, and formation of a new solid; the melting-ghee mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. The melting-ice idea was not corrected yet, so at home, ask Ananya to explain why freezing and melting water remain the same substance.
